elements.element: Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 still prohibits the Company from participating in projects similar to the Site involving Deerskin Products and grants HDI an exclusive field-of-use right.

elements.element: The restriction covers only a named competing product.
elements.evidence: The restriction is limited to “Deerskin Products”; references to substantially similar products and companies were removed.

elements.element: The restriction applies during the term only.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 expressly applies “during the term of this Agreement,” and Section 6.1 is not included in the survival clause.

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: The restriction applies “in no event for more than twelve (12) months.”

elements.element: The restriction permits Customer's internal development.
elements.evidence: The restriction expressly does not apply to “the Company's internal development.”
The restriction expressly does not apply to “any acquisition by or of the Company.”
